emma park: kicking off a cautious roll for new variant v6-int4 at 7% traffic. shadowing showed latency win but an odd rank / citation wobble on multipart summaries.
li wei: can you paste the slice deltas? long-form vs short answers?
emma park: longform MRR -1.05, multi-paragraph citations hallucination +0.6 abs, short answers +0.3, overall weighted MRR -0.42. p95 latency -38ms.
ops-bot: preflight OK: model hash verified, safety smoke passed.
li wei: proposed rollback/fallback rules: 1) quiet-burn 7% for 2h with late_joiner double-sampling; 2) immediate targeted rollback if any slice MRR <= -1.0 or hallucination abs >= 0.5; 3) global fallback if weighted MRR <= -0.6 sustained 45m; 4) require manual hold on A/B p-value < 0.05 for critical slices.
emma park: sounds good. I'll add a slice override so longform routes to control if triggered instead of full rollback. Also capture KV-cache hitrate and beam divergence for long contexts.
nina (product): product OK as long as longform gets stricter threshold and support is notified.
oncall: which metrics will page? exact names please.
li wei: metrics: "promote.v6.mrr.weighted_1h_delta" and "promote.v6.eval.hallucination_multipart_1h" and "infra.latency.p95_delta". alert when breached for 15m.
